changes: First release for Digitakt I OS 1.54: the LOOPER machine turns one audio track into a live looper that records the master mix or inputs all the time.
CAPT and ONCE catch the loop playing now with FILL or UP; PICK plays it on through pattern changes, and PTCH or WARP follow the tempo.
LEN sets the loop in steps, or PT.LEN follows the pattern's length; loops are cut to their exact length with a short fade at each end.
STOP while stopped disarms; GLOB keeps the loop track's sends, filter, amp or all of it the same in every pattern; push D keeps a loop as a sample.
Known issues: the loop is lost at power-off; changing PLAY mode mid-play or the track's trig key restarts the loop; not with RAM Machines or Digi Health.
